snippet.title: Build, Eat Cheese, Defy the Gods | Demo Out Now - Zoe and the Cursed Dreamer
snippet.description:
A Demon God awakens... but maybe that's someone else's problem.

Howdy, everyone! I have just launched the demo for my game Zoe and the Cursed Dreamer! ZatCD is a 2D Pixel Art game made with the Godot Engine. A cozy open world RPG where you’ll meet quirky characters, live in the village as a member of the community, and help guide them through the dark and desperate times ahead.

Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576680/Zoe_and_the_Cursed_Dreamer/
Itch: https://game-endeavor.itch.io/zatcd

Join Our Community!
Discord: https://discord.gg/w7qh74M
